# Backend Specification Quality Checklist: Student Reward System Backend

**Purpose**: Comprehensive requirements quality review validating completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, scenario coverage, edge cases, transactional invariants, and security/privacy isolation across the backend specification.  
**Created**: 2026-09-24  
**Feature**: [specs/001-student-reward-backend/spec.md](../spec.md)  

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.  

---

## 1. Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are bootstrap requirements for the initial school administrator provisioning fully specified with exact input fields and initial state? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-076]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are verification evidence requirements for challenge and mission submissions defined with explicit supported attachment formats, storage expectations, and file size limits? [Completeness, Spec §FR-088, Clarifications 2026-09-19]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are the triggering schedule, timezone semantics, and idempotency rules for daily end-of-day balance snapshots explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-062, §FR-078]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is the predefined catalog of guidance card logo identifiers explicitly enumerated or referenced? [Completeness, Spec §FR-064, §FR-091]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are data export schema specifications, column layouts, and payload structures documented for CSV, Excel, and PDF formats? [Completeness, Spec §FR-071, Key Entities §Report]

## 2. Requirement Clarity & Precision

- [ ] CHK006 - Is the format, character set, and validation pattern of the 10-digit national ID explicitly quantified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is the duration of the temporary submission ban ("approximately one month") quantified with an exact temporal metric (e.g., 30 calendar days)? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-042, User Story 5 §Scenario 5]
- [ ] CHK008 - Are tier threshold evaluation boundaries specified as inclusive or exclusive ($\ge$ vs $>$)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-060, §FR-061, Key Entities §Student Tier Configuration]
- [ ] CHK009 - Are the semantic states and display color mappings (`Pending to Approve` [Blue], `Pending to Receive` [Blue], `Completed` [Green], `Declined` [Red]) unambiguously defined for all reward request transitions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-030-FR-033, User Story 4]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the size and display threshold for "top-student boards" quantified (e.g., top 3, top 5, or top 10 students)? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-057, §FR-058]

## 3. Requirement Consistency & Alignment

- [ ] CHK011 - Is the semantic distinction between teacher award-budget balances and student reward-point balances maintained consistently across all requirements and entities? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, §FR-082, Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK012 - Do student lifecycle rules consistently distinguish between class reassignment (preserves balance and requests) and departure (removes balance and requests)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, §FR-010, User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are price and point immutability rules consistent across catalog rewards (immutable), challenges/missions (immutable point value), and task proposals (editable prior to completion)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-025, §FR-036, §FR-046]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are cancellation constraints consistent between reward requests (student cancellation strictly prohibited at all stages) and task proposals (cancellation permitted only in `Ready to Do` status)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-029, §FR-047]

## 4. Acceptance Criteria & Measurability

- [ ] CHK015 - Is the standard competition ranking algorithm (1, 2, 2, 4) specified with objective mathematical formulas and rank-skipping criteria for arbitrary tie combinations? [Measurability, Spec §FR-054, §FR-055, User Story 7 §Scenario 1]
- [ ] CHK016 - Can the success criterion of zero unauthorized negative balances across all point operations be objectively verified and tested? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §FR-022, §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK017 - Are testable acceptance criteria defined for atomic inventory deduction when multiple requests contend for the last unit of a non-approval reward? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Story 4 §Scenario 5, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 - Are performance thresholds (e.g., $<100\text{ms}$ p95 for point transactions) specified with measurable operational parameters and load conditions? [Measurability, Non-Functional, Plan §Technical Context]

## 5. Scenario & Lifecycle Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 - Are requirements specified for teacher lifecycle transitions, distinguishing deactivation (preserves assignments/balance, blocks actions) from departure (removes assignments, relationships, and balance)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012, §FR-014, User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are exception and recovery flows specified for challenge verification rejection accumulation, ban application, and manual administrator unban overrides? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Recovery, Spec §FR-041-FR-043]
- [ ] CHK021 - Are rollback and compensation requirements specified when an administrator removes a reward from the catalog while requests are active in `Pending to Approve` or `Pending to Receive`? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §FR-034, User Story 4 §Scenario 10]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are all valid state transitions and terminal states documented for student voluntary task proposals (`Pending to Approve` $\rightarrow$ `Ready to Do` $\rightarrow$ `Completed` / `Declined` / `Canceled`)? [Coverage, State Machine, Spec §FR-044-FR-048]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are requirements specified for bidirectional in-request message threading and timestamp preservation throughout the proposal lifecycle? [Coverage, Spec §FR-049, §FR-050, §FR-090]

## 6. Edge Cases & Boundary Conditions

- [ ] CHK024 - Does the spec define system behavior when concurrent point award requests attempt to deduct more points than a teacher currently holds? [Edge Case, Concurrency, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are boundary requirements specified for simultaneous reward requests against a non-approval reward with inventory equal to 1? [Edge Case, Concurrency, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK026 - Does the spec explicitly define validation behavior when an administrator attempts a direct point deduction exceeding a student's current balance? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK027 - Are award eligibility rules clearly defined when a teacher holds multiple subject assignments within the same class? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-011, §FR-081]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are requirements explicit that inactive, deactivated, or departed students are excluded from active population denominators in ranking ratios (e.g., `15 of 32`)? [Boundary Condition, Spec §FR-056, §FR-058, User Story 7 §Scenario 2]
- [ ] CHK029 - Does the spec define validation behavior for zero-point or negative-point transfer, award, or proposal approval attempts? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-017]

## 7. Transactional Concurrency & Data Integrity (High-Risk Gate)

- [ ] CHK030 - Are database-level non-negative balance constraints (`CHECK (balance >= 0)`) explicitly specified to guarantee ledger integrity independent of application logic? [Data Integrity, Spec §SC-001, Constitution §IV, Plan §Constraints]
- [ ] CHK031 - Are transactional atomicity requirements documented for administrator point transfers (atomic pool debit + teacher budget credit + audit write)? [Transactional Invariant, Spec §FR-016, §FR-066, §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK032 - Are atomic point reservation and immediate balance deduction requirements specified for reward redemption requests to eliminate double-spend windows? [Transactional Invariant, Spec §FR-027, §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK033 - Are atomic point release and balance restoration requirements specified for reward request rejections and catalog item deletions? [Data Integrity, Spec §FR-032, §FR-034]

## 8. Security, Privacy & Role Isolation (High-Risk Gate)

- [ ] CHK034 - Are student privacy requirements defined to prevent students from viewing names or point balances of non-top peers when accessing rankings? [Privacy, Role Isolation, Spec §FR-058, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK035 - Are multi-tenant / class isolation requirements specified to prevent teachers from viewing point history, reports, or profiles of students in non-assigned classes? [Security, Role Isolation, Spec §FR-063, §FR-070, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK036 - Are confidentiality requirements specified to strictly isolate student voluntary task proposals and message threads from teachers and peer students? [Security, Privacy, Spec §FR-051, §FR-053, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK037 - Are credential protection requirements defined to prevent passwords, hashes, and session tokens from being exposed in responses, views, error messages, or logs? [Security, Spec §FR-005, §FR-075, Constitution §V]
- [ ] CHK038 - Are authentication failure responses specified to return generic error messages that avoid leaking account existence or ID validity? [Security, Spec §User Story 1 §Scenario 3]

## 9. Audit Immutability & Compliance (High-Risk Gate)

- [ ] CHK039 - Is the permanent, append-only, write-only invariant of point audit logs explicitly specified, rejecting all modification and deletion attempts from all roles? [Audit Integrity, Spec §FR-068, §SC-002, Constitution §IV]
- [ ] CHK040 - Is unique request correlation ID (`X-Correlation-Id`) assignment and propagation across all application layers and audit records explicitly specified? [Observability, Traceability, Spec §FR-072, §FR-073, Constitution §VII]
- [ ] CHK041 - Are audit capture requirements complete across all 10 point-modifying event types (pool transfer, teacher award, admin adjustment, reward reservation, reward receive, reward decline, reward removal return, challenge award, proposal award, departure deduction)? [Completeness, Traceability, Spec §FR-066, §FR-083]
- [ ] CHK042 - Are on-demand parameterized report queries specified with role-scoped filtering rules without requiring persisted filter entities? [Clarity, Spec §FR-069, §FR-070, Clarifications 2026-09-19]

## 10. Non-Functional & Operational Requirements

- [ ] CHK043 - Are structured JSON completion logging requirements defined with log levels, execution duration, correlation ID, and sensitive data scrubbing? [Observability, Spec §FR-074, §FR-075, Constitution §VII]
- [ ] CHK044 - Are semantic error propagation requirements defined to prevent application errors from losing original semantic cause or stack context across layers? [Observability, Spec §FR-073, Constitution §VII]
